title: Fresh review-pr chain request and task inputs
description: An isolated authenticated gateway and checkout-local CLI prove the fresh-chain flag, persistence, predecessor exclusion and conflicting-request refusal. A separate manual task writer check proves the absence of prior-review input and instructions. No reviewer, product run or provider write occurs.

request-policy.intent: Create an isolated review request through the actual CLI and gateway, keep fresh selection on disk, reject standing-policy defaults and inherited lineage, and keep previous runs unchanged.

comparison-policy.cmd: node --input-type=module -e 'import fs from "node:fs"; import assert from "node:assert/strict"; const r=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("temp/fresh-review-chain/rpc.json","utf8")); const m=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("temp/fresh-review-chain/materialization.json","utf8")); assert(m.comparisonInputsOmitted); assert(r.comparisonDefaultFresh && r.comparisonModeOverridesWarmDefault && r.explicitComparisonLineagePreserved); console.log("Authenticated comparison default and explicit-lineage exception verified");'
comparison-policy.intent: Verify the actual gateway selects a fresh comparison chain before a WARM farm default and preserves explicitly requested primary lineage.

task-inputs.intent: Materialize the existing static review task without a previous-review file or instruction.
